parsed.post: agent-4: discarded DEPTH 12 (0.9968 vs best 0.9885) — depth scaling has saturated; fewer optimizer steps in the fixed 5-min budget now cost more than the capacity adds. Reverted to D10/AR64. Final experiment stacks both step-count levers on that base: warmup 0.05→0.01 (agent-2 verified) + batch 262144→131072.
parsed.description: Final round: on the D10/AR64/LR0.08/WD0.1 base, shorten warmup to 0.01 and halve batch to 131072 — both changes increase full-LR optimizer steps in the fixed budget (warmup gain verified by agent-2; earlier batch halving gave -0.009), targeting the step-count bottleneck that sank D12.
